key_insight: GraphMuon adapts matrix-structured optimization to graph-propagated features, mitigating update amplification that vanilla Muon can experience in GNNs.
engineering_relevance: Graph-aware parameter updates can reduce GNN training time to a target validation loss while maintaining competitive predictive performance.
method: Use the covariance of graph-propagated layer inputs to define an update metric.
Orthogonalize matrix updates in this graph-aware metric.
Normalize step sizes by their induced effect on layer representations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 1.32×–2.42× validation-loss time-to-target speedups over AdamW on three large-scale OGB benchmarks and lower time-to-target in 13 of 15 dataset–architecture configurations.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify the memory or computation overhead of covariance-aware updates, so assess these costs on your target graph and architecture.
paper_title: Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks
